title: Sagat manifest
description: Which workflows a namespace has and where their documents are, kept in Git and read by `sagat` (feature 011). This schema holds what a single manifest says on its own; the checks that need more than one field or the files (no name or file listed twice, a document that is the workflow it is listed as, a file that stays below the directory of the manifest after links are followed) are made by the tool and are described in the quickstart.

slug.description: Lower case letters, digits and single hyphens, starting with a letter, not ending in a hyphen, 3 to 63 characters: what the platform accepts as a name.

file.description: A relative path below the directory of the manifest, to a JSON or YAML workflow document.
